instruction: Change the content text to appear in italics.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making the content text (the description about neural networks) italic. Original content is not italic. Custom getter extracts italic status of content text (non-title text with font size < 40pt), and custom metric checks if content text is italicized.

llm_judge_reasons: Metric correctly checks ALL content items and calculates percentage (italic_count / total_count) for proper verification (metrics/pptx.py:26-30)
Getter uses robust content detection: Primary method uses placeholder type checks (PP_PLACEHOLDER_TYPE.BODY, OBJECT, SUBTITLE), with font size <40pt as fallback heuristic (getters/pptx.py:38-61)
Evaluator provides partial credit scoring: If 3 out of 5 content items are italic, score = 0.6, requiring ALL content italic for full score (1.0)
Postconfig properly saves file (Ctrl+S) to persist formatting changes before verification
Minor issue: No baseline verification that content was originally non-italic, but metadata confirms 'Original content is not italic' for this specific task
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding baseline state check in getter to verify content was non-italic before task execution (would require storing pre-task state)
Font size threshold (40pt) for title detection is reasonable but could vary across templates - current placeholder-based primary detection mitigates this
